title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
Role: Senior Data Scientist
  
  
Location: Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
Years of Experience: 6+ years
  
  
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That's what makes us Roche.
  
  
**Mission**
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics- and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. GATE enables data-led decision-making and innovation across healthcare and biotech operations
  
  
You will work closely with the U.S. Strategic Customer Support Consulting team dedicated to Roche's most important diagnostic customers — large reference laboratories, hospital networks, and integrated health systems. The team's mandate is to help these customers run more resilient, efficient, and cost-effective supply chain operations.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
As the Senior Data Scientist in this team, you will own the forecasting, optimization, and machine learning work that underpins our customer engagements. You will inherit and evolve an existing production forecasting engine, harden it for scale across accounts, and extend it into a broader supply chain optimization framework. You will also provide recommendations and strategic support on other various customer supply chain initiatives, related to forecasting, optimization and machine learning.
  
  
This is a hybrid technical–consultative role. Roughly half your impact will come from the depth and rigor of the models you build; the other half will come from your ability to sit across the table from a senior customer stakeholder, understand their operational reality, and convert a model output into a decision they act on.
  
  
Experience in Gen AI, LLM, NLP, and ML Ops will be considered an added advantage, supporting Roche's future-ready analytics and AI roadmap.
  
  
**How You'll Work**
You will be part of a wider data and analytics community at Roche, and your best work will happen in partnership with it. You will collaborate closely with our product and visualization teams to make sure the models you build reach business and customer teams as clear, usable views — translating forecasts, inventory recommendations, and risk signals into the reports and interfaces people actually work from. You must operate well with ambiguity and changing priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the data science lead on strategic consulting engagements for Roche's top diagnostic customers, partnering with consultants and account teams from problem framing through to delivered impact
* Engage directly with business consultants — primarily through virtual forums, to scope problems, test hypotheses, and align on success measures
* Translate customer supply chain pain points — stockouts, over-ordering, bottlenecks, working capital lock-up, erratic consumption, expiry and wastage — into well-posed modelling problems, and then into deployed, usable solutions
* Deliver consumption forecasting and replenishment recommendations at the customer account level, helping customers order the right quantity at the right time, and helping Roche plan against real downstream demand
* Work internally with other technology teams to ensure solutions built can be used throughout the transition to ASPIRE and other similar system changes (i.e. Agility/ARID migration to Snowflake, Google to Microsoft)
* Drive and support industry-leading initiatives such as a Digital Twin Risk Analysis for scenario planning and modeling, Inventory Rightsizing and Safety Stock Analysis tools, Freight and Network Optimization modeling, and Carbon Footprint tracking and reduction
* Collaborate on Agentic AI capabilities on top of existing and future databases and tools
* Build reusable models, methodologies, and accelerators that the consulting team can deploy repeatedly across accounts, rather than rebuilding bespoke solutions each time
* Present modelling results, business cases, and quantified impact (service level, working capital, wastage reduction) to senior internal and external audiences through clear, persuasive storytelling
* Capture learning from each engagement and feed it back into the team's models, methods, and scalable offerings

**Who You Are:**
You are a hands-on technical builder with 6+ years of experience in hands-on data science, with demonstrable specialization in forecasting. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in a technical–consultative role, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready models.
  
  
**Qualifications & Technical Skillset:**

* Master's or Bachelor’s in Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics, or a related quantitative discipline
* 6+ years of hands-on data science experience, with demonstrable specialization in forecasting — you have owned production forecasting systems, not just built proofs of concept
* Deep, practical command of state-of-the-art time-series techniques: hierarchical forecasting and reconciliation, intermittent-demand methods, probabilistic/quantile forecasting, global vs. local model strategies, and modern neural forecasting architectures
* Hands-on experience building models using algorithms and techniques such as multivariate regression, time series analysis, XGBoost, clustering, classification, OLS regression, and causal inference methods
* Proven experience in inventory optimization, replenishment policy design, and/or supply chain network modelling, with a track record of delivering measurable service-level or working-capital impact
* Demonstrated experience working directly with external customers or clients — you are comfortable running workshops, presenting to senior stakeholders, handling challenges in the room, and building credibility with non-technical audiences. Prior consulting, client-facing data science, or customer success experience is strongly preferred
* Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — you can move fluently between a model diagnostic conversation with an engineer and a value conversation with a customer executive
* Comfortable building trust and running effective customer engagements remotely — virtual workshops, video-based executive presentations, and asynchronous collaboration across time zones
* Good working knowledge of reporting and visualization practice — you understand how dashboards are designed and consumed, and can partner effectively with visualization teams to specify what business and customer audiences need to see. Familiarity with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik is an advantage
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience using libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow, pandas, NumPy, Spark, and forecasting-specific tooling (e.g., Prophet, statsforecast/Nixtla, GluonTS, Darts)
* Experience with optimization solvers and OR libraries (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, PuLP, Pyomo)
* Experience deploying and maintaining models in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with modern ML Ops tooling (MLflow, Airflow/Dagster, Kedro, Docker, CI/CD)
* Experience taking models from prototype to productized capability
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset

**Strong to have:**

* Understanding of diagnostics and pharmaceutical supply chains — reagents and consumables, cold chain, shelf life and expiry management, installed-base-driven consumption, and lab workflow dynamics
* Experience designing alerting and exception-scoring models in a production decision-support setting
* Familiarity with GxP, validated environments, and regulated-industry documentation practices
* Experience with GenAI, LLMs, NLP, and agentic workflows applied to operational decision support
* Prior experience working in a global capability centre or shared-services model, partnering across time zones and affiliates
* Experience presenting to internal and external business stakeholders (?)
* Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: AI Tech Lead - 8 to 10 years - Immediate Joiners
description:
**AI Tech Lead / AI Architect**

**India (Hybrid) | Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time | Hands-on GenAI Delivery Leadership**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on 
**AI Tech Lead**
 to lead one or more Generative AI delivery pods for a financial-services client. The role sits between our Senior AI Engineers and the Engagement Manager.

You own the technical direction and day-to-day delivery of your pod: you design the architecture, review the work and unblock it, and you are the technical voice with client architects, platform and security teams. You turn business asks into designs, plans and estimates, and you are accountable for

**what goes to production.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

1. 
**Solution Architecture:**
Own the architecture for GenAI applications (RAG, agentic workflows, document intelligence, evaluation and guardrails) on Azure: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, APIM or an AI gateway.

2. 
**Engineering Standards:**
Set and enforce branching and PR reviews, testing, IaC (Terraform), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), observability, security and cost practices.

3. 
**Trade-off Decisions:**
Make and document the calls on model choice and routing, retrieval design, latency and cost, and build versus buy, so the team and the client can follow them.

4. 
**Evaluation & Guardrails:**
Build evaluation in from the start: golden datasets, regression gates on every prompt or code change, LLM-as-judge where it fits, content filters and human review for high-risk outputs.

5. 
**Production Readiness:**
Run release readiness: UAT support, release notes, rollback plans and production hand-off.

**People, Delivery & Client Leadership**

● 
**Pod Leadership:**
Lead a pod of 4-8 engineers (AI, backend, data, full-stack): plan sprints, allocate work, review code and designs, and grow each person. You are the first escalation point for your pod.

● 
**Delivery Ownership:**
Estimate, plan and track delivery; surface risks and dependencies early (environments, access, client approvals) and drive them to closure.

● 
**Client Technical Lead:**
Act as the senior technical point of contact with client architects, platform, security and governance teams; lead design walkthroughs, demos and technical decisions.

● 
**Scoping & Communication:**
Translate vague business asks into scoped solutions and phased plans, push back with options when a request is not feasible, and work with the Engagement Manager on scope, staffing and status.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

● 
**Overall Professional Experience:**
8-12 years in software or data/ML engineering, with progressive technical leadership.

● 
**AI/ML & GenAI Experience:**
3+ years building and shipping Generative AI applications to production.

● 
**Team Leadership:**
At least 2 years leading engineers: allocation, reviews, mentoring and delivery accountability.
**Core Technical Competencies**

● 
**Generative AI & LLMs:**
Hands-on depth in LLM application patterns (RAG, hybrid search and re-ranking, agents and tools/MCP, structured outputs) and evaluation/observability tooling (RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse or similar).

● 
**Azure AI Platform:**
Production experience with Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, Key Vault, private networking and Entra ID / managed identity. AWS experience is acceptable with a clear path to Azure.

● 
**Responsible AI & Security:**
Content filters and guardrails, prompt-injection and data-leakage risks, PII handling, access

control and audit logging in a regulated (financial services) environment.

● 
**Backend & DevOps:**
Strong Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO), Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and environment promotion (dev / UAT / prod) with rollback.

● 
**Communication:**
Clear written and spoken communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience & Education**

● Financial services or asset-management domain experience.

● AI gateway / API management (APIM, Kong), model routing and cost control; document intelligence and OCR (Azure Document Intelligence / Content Understanding).

● Working knowledge of React for chat and operations UIs.

title: Systems Integration Advisor
description:

392699
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Advisor to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Design and build the SQL Server data foundation for the monitoring solution, converting raw SSAS/ALETL telemetry into traceable, historised, queryable and Power BI-ready information.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform source-to-metric mapping for ALETL logs, RunContext, SSAS DMVs and Extended Event outputs.
* Design logical and physical data models covering raw, staging, curated, dimension, fact, snapshot, configuration, audit, exception and serving layers.
* Define fact grain, keys, conformed dimensions, SCD/history patterns, indexing and retention design.
* Develop advanced T-SQL procedures, views and transformations for monitoring and observability data.
* Parse dbo.ALETL\_Log messages into structured category, object, status, duration, error and correlation fields.
* Correlate processing events using available identifiers and RunContext information without relying only on timestamps.
* Implement duplicate detection, malformed/incomplete event quarantine, auditability and safe rerun/reprocessing patterns.
* Build derived metrics, snapshots, baselines, trends and threshold-supporting data structures.
* Create approved SQL serving views for Power BI and support source-to-report reconciliation.
* Optimise SQL queries, indexes and data structures for expected monitoring volumes and collection frequencies.
* Package database changes using SSDT/DACPAC/Git-aligned deployment practices.
* Perform developer unit testing and support SIT/UAT defect analysis and correction.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Advanced T-SQL and strong SQL Server development skills.
* Logical and physical data modelling.
* Dimensional modelling: facts, dimensions, grain and conformed dimensions.
* Historisation patterns including snapshots and SCD1/SCD2 where appropriate.
* Stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query optimisation.
* Log parsing, event correlation and data transformation.
* Error handling, auditability, duplicate prevention and safe rerun design.
* SSDT/DACPAC and Git/source-control based database delivery.
* Ability to build Power BI-ready serving views.

**Desirable Skills**

* SSAS Multidimensional data/metadata familiarity.
* Experience with monitoring, telemetry or operational data.
* SQL Agent or equivalent scheduling experience.
* Banking or regulated-enterprise data-platform experience.

**Recommended Experience**
Recommended: 8+ years in SQL Server/data engineering, with strong hands-on experience designing production-grade data models and transformation logic.
  
  
**Expected Project Deliverables / Contribution**

* Logical and physical monitoring data model.
* ALETL parsing and event-correlation logic.
* Raw/staging/curated/fact/dimension/snapshot/configuration/audit structures.
* Derived metric and threshold-supporting SQL logic.
* Power BI serving views and deployment artefacts.

**About NTT DATA**

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. description:
About Arivula

Arivula Technologies LLP is an AI-native product company building innovative technology products from India. We believe curiosity, commitment and the ability to learn deeply matter more than existing qualifications.

Our Foundational Internship is a structured six-month program designed to develop capabilities, discover potential and build our future teams.

Your Internship Journey

The program progresses through three stages:

**1. Research, Learn & Communicate**

Explore unfamiliar concepts through first-principles thinking. Participate in research, technical storytelling, script development and AI-assisted conceptual animation.

**2. Explore Technology Through Challenges**

Work on practical technical challenges, experiment with different technologies, solve problems and discover your strengths.

**3. Choose Your Stream & Own Real Work**

Progress toward one of four career pathways:

* **Product Development:**

* **Applied AI:**
  Develop intelligent applications, agents and workflows.
* **AI Model Development:**

* **Intellectual Media:**

What We Offer

* Structured, personalized and technology-assisted mentorship.
* Opportunities to contribute to meaningful products and intellectual media.
* Necessary software, AI tools and technical resources.
* Flexible, outcome-oriented working arrangements.
* A pathway toward full-time employment based on demonstrated capability and dependability.

Internship Details

**Duration:**
6 months

**Stipend:**
Unpaid

**Commitment:**
Predominantly full-time, with flexible working hours and outcome-based expectations.

**Location:**
Chennai, with remote, office and hybrid arrangements available.

**Eligibility:**
No prior technical experience required. Final-semester students may receive special consideration.

Interns are expected to have their own laptops.

Full-Time Opportunities

There is no fixed hiring quota. Every intern who demonstrates exceptional performance and meets Arivula's dependability standards will be offered a suitable full-time role.

Qualifying full-time conversions receive a joining bonus of
**₹1 lakh to ₹1.5 lakh**
.

How to Apply

If this opportunity interests you, please write to
**careers@arivula.com**
expressing your interest.

We will share a detailed overview of the internship, including the program structure, expectations and application process.

We encourage candidates to read through the overview carefully, ask questions and make an informed decision before applying.

title: Associate - Asset Management Performance Attribution Reporting
description:
**Job Title:**
Associate
  
  
**Department**
: Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Asset Management Reporting is responsible for transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function supports multiple reporting types across asset classes, geographies, and regulatory regimes.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Validator role acts as the independent quality, control, and risk assurance layer within the Asset Management Reporting lifecycle. The role ensures that all reports produced are technically accurate, conceptually sound, methodologically consistent, and compliant with internal standards, client requirements, and regulatory expectations before final release.
  
  
The Validator is accountable for challenging outputs, validating assumptions, and preventing incorrect or misleading information from reaching clients or regulators.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform independent validation of reports produced by Processors, focusing on accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriateness.
* Review calculations, methodologies, disclosures, narratives, and trends across reporting periods.
* Execute second-level controls and formally evidence validation and sign-off.
* Ensure outputs align with documented procedures, regulatory guidance, and client expectations.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Challenge unusual movements, overrides, or explanations and ensure they are supported by facts and documentation.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring errors, or control weaknesses and escalate with root-cause analysis.
* Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory reviews with clear explanations and evidence.
* Provide feedback and guidance to Processors to improve overall quality maturity.
* Contribute to strengthening control frameworks and standardization.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Strong conceptual understanding of Asset Management Reporting, including performance, holdings, regulatory disclosures, and client reporting objectives.
* Ability to interpret and validate complex data flows across investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data domains.
* Solid knowledge of control frameworks, audit expectations, and risk management principles.
* Capability to assess methodological appropriateness and not just numerical accuracy.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Demonstrates rigorous professional judgment, proactively questioning assumptions and constructively challenging perspectives to drive robust decision-making.
* Strong attention to detail combined with a big-picture understanding of reporting impact.
* Clear and structured communication, especially when explaining issues, risks, or decisions.
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for quality and risk prevention.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak reporting cycles without compromising control standards.

**Specific Qualifications**
Post Graduate degree in Finance or a related discipline.
  
  
Strong understanding of performance measurement and attribution methodologies, including arithmetic and geometric attribution approaches.
  
  
Knowledge of key attribution models such as Brinson-Fachler / Brinson-Hood-Beebower, including allocation, selection, and interaction effects.
  
  
Familiarity with portfolio return calculations, benchmark comparison, and relative performance analysis across asset classes.
  
  
Ability to interpret and validate attribution results by linking performance drivers to investment decisions, market movements, and portfolio positioning.
  
  
Experience working with holdings, transactions, benchmark data, pricing, and FX data used in performance calculations.
  
  
Understanding of multi-asset and multi-currency portfolios, including impact of currency and derivative exposures on performance.
  
  
Ability to perform reconciliation and variance analysis between performance systems and reporting outputs.
  
  
Familiarity with performance attribution tools/platforms and reporting systems used in Asset Management.
  
  
Awareness of data dependencies, assumptions, and limitations within attribution models and reporting outputs.
  
  
Prior experience in Performance Attribution, Performance Measurement, or Investment Reporting roles is preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(**
**Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Asset Management Reporting concepts (performance, holdings, regulatory disclosures)
+ Data validation and reconciliation techniques
+ Advanced Excel; familiarity with reporting platforms and databases
+ Understanding of control frameworks and audit expectations
+ Understanding of asset management products and reporting methodologies

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Accountability and ownership
+ Analytical thinking
+ Clear written and verbal communication
+ Ability to work under peak delivery pressure

**Power BI Architect – Reports Migration Expert**

The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in Power BI , Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, SQL, data visualization, and BI architecture, combined with strong experience in automating repetitive report-development and migration activities
  
  

* Lead the architecture and technical strategy for migrating legacy BI /reporting platforms to Power BI .

* Define automated report comparison and validation frameworks to ensure migrated reports produce results equivalent to legacy reports.
* Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and mentoring to Power BI developers.

**Required Technical Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in Data engineering domain & enterprise reports building with at least 2 projects experience in migration from legacy reporting technologies to Power BI .
* The candidate should have very strong hands-on Power BI expertise, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Report Server, Power BI semantic models/datasets, DAX – advanced/expert level, Power Query / M, Data modelling, Star schema / dimensional modelling, Composite models, Import and DirectQuery, Incremental refresh, Aggregations, Calculation groups, Row-Level Security (RLS), Object-Level Security (OLS), Drill-through, Bookmarks, Dynamic measures, Field parameters, Dynamic titles and visualization, Custom visuals, Power BI performance optimization, Deployment pipelines, Workspaces and governance
* Experience migrating reports from one or more legacy platforms is highly desirable, for example SAP BusinessObjects, IBM Cognos, MicroStrategy, Tableau, Qlik, SSRS, Crystal Reports, Oracle BI / OBIEE

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. * You will have the opportunity to occasionally travel to customers and discover new places and cultures along the way.
* Team training sessions and access to online learning portals will ensure that your knowledge stays up-to-date and allow you to grow beyond your current know-how.
* From on the edge software development, designing advanced machines, defining and implementing image processing algorithms or crafting new ways to do optical inspections, we do it all, and we need your talent to keep going one step beyond!

* Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
* Minimum an MS degree in engineering with at least 5 years of experience.
* Extensive programming skills in modern C++.
* Knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, and UML.
* An affinity to vision applications is a plus.
* Knowledge of C#, WPF, Python, GIT and Scrum are a plus.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently without guidance as an Individual contributor.
* Proficient in English

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*

Use tests, code review and user acceptance testing to prevent misleading metrics, filter behaviour or exports.Use approved AI coding tools where useful; review generated code and validate logic before release. Maintain version control, technical documentation and a prioritized backlog with users.Migrate and retire legacy BI (Power BI) dashboards as the Python stack matures, so refresh cycles are no longer constrained by the old setup.Required Experience and Qualifications:2 to 5 years of relevant Python dashboard, analytical application or web development experience, with examples of applications deployed for business users.A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical development experience.Strong Python and SQL skills, including pandas and experience building interactive applications with Dash and Plotly or a comparable Python web framework.Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, callback or application state management, APIs and debugging web applications.Experience connecting dashboards to databases, validating calculated metrics, managing performance and maintaining production applications.Practical knowledge of Git, testing, Linux-based deployment, authentication and authorization. Ability to work with IT on secure internal hosting.Ability to clarify business metric definitions, present data accurately and collaborate with analysts, Data Scientists and Risk users.Preferred Experience and Qualifications:Prior lending or credit risk scorecard monitoring experience, including Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, vintage analysis, deciles and matured bad-rate reporting.Experience with GCP and BigQuery, query optimization, caching, scheduled data refreshes and monitoring multiple model versions.Experience with enterprise SSO, role-based access, Docker, reverse proxies or deployment through CI/CD.Experience using AI-assisted development productively while retaining code review, tests, data protection and calculation validation.What Success Looks Like:A reusable dashboard framework makes monitoring available quickly after go-live and supports frequent scorecard refreshes.Metrics reconcile to agreed definitions, with clear maturity, freshness and sample-size information.Dashboards remain responsive, secure and useful for identifying degradation and directing investigation.Who are we looking for?We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.Willingness to go the extra mile for success.Energetic and lively, and street smart.As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.About Tonik:We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. title: Associate Manager, GBS CPM
description:
**Overview**
**Job Summary**

* Actively managing the Bank’s credit portfolio to maximise risk-adjusted returns for sustainable Group RoTE outcomes through better origination discipline, portfolio optimisation, modelling, early identification and action of stressed assets and distribution. Driving balance sheet optimisation and resilience through improving the inter-operability of key subsidiaries, reducing Cost of Funds (CoF) and improving quality and resilience of liabilities by monetising illiquid CIB loans to create medium term secured and contingent funding options that could even be used to raise funds in stress.

**Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM)**

description:

The advisor is an important gatekeeper who would carry out the following activities:

* Subject matter expert and focal on economics for helping in decision making in the market.

* Conduct and facilitate “Post investment reviews” and actions to improve economic modelling and forecasting.
* Bring deep understanding of underlying business plans and performance to aid investment decision making in the market.

* Quality reviews and economic evaluations
* Robust and fit-for-purpose uncertainty and risk analysis (decision analysis support),
* Effective and timely challenge, guidance, and support in making quality investment decisions,
* Economic discipline sub-team participation.
* Drive CI initiatives to improve economics and premise data for investment decisions.
* Progress ESSA (eliminate, standardize, simplify and Automate) projects and embed process excellence through digitalization and CI Mindset
* Work closely with Finance Manager to support forecasting and modelling of significant changes in business and adhoc analysis as needed from a value and risk perspective.
* Custodian and implementer of economic standards governed by Downstream business.

**What You Bring**

* Well-rounded finance professional (MBA, CA, CFA, CIMA, ACCA etc.)
* 10 -12 years' experience in finance (preferably with financial modelling, equity research, transaction support, and investment analysis).

* Project management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management - The ability to achieve results through influencing and motivating others (inside and outside finance) and to communicate effectively across all hierarchies within the organization.
* Problem solving mindset with the courage to ensure professional financial rigor is applied to decision-making process.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, commercial mindset and analytical aptitude; demonstrating good collaboration & interpersonal skills.
* Be organized and structured in completion of tasks.
* Prior relevant business/technical experience in Financial Valuation and research is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of SAP ERP systems and reporting tools like Power BI is a plus.
* Knowledge and ability to work with VBA/Macros is a plus.
* Ability to apply a risk-based, practical approach to problem solving, coupled with the ability to rationalize decisions with significant uncertainty and incomplete info.
* Self-starter with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skills (listening, inquiry, advocacy, facilitation and negotiation) and overall stakeholder engagement skills
* Willingness and capacity to dive into analytical details, and surface with crisp summary of key insights.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,
**click here.**
**Shell India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from process analysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
'

title: Research Associate - Medical Devices & Imaging
description:
**About The Team / Practice Area**
The Medical Devices & Imaging cluster within TechVision tracks emerging and disruptive technologies transforming diagnosis, intervention, monitoring, rehabilitation, and care delivery. The team connects scientific and engineering advances with clinical needs, regulatory pathways, adoption dynamics, commercial potential, and growth opportunities across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our analysts engage with medical-device and imaging companies, healthcare providers, clinicians, researchers, universities, startups, investors, regulators, standards bodies, technology developers, and manufacturing partners. This ecosystem perspective helps the team evaluate technology maturity, clinical utility, competitive differentiation, implementation barriers, and routes to commercialization.
  
  
The cluster delivers syndicated research, technology scouting, opportunity assessments, benchmarking and prioritization studies, innovator and partner landscapes, growth opportunity analysis, executive briefings, workshops, and customized consulting engagements for medtech, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, life-science, and healthcare organizations.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Research Associate is a full-time entry-level position, ideal for a recent graduate or a candidate with 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in medical devices, biomedical engineering, medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare research, life sciences, market intelligence, or a related field.
  
  
The associate will support the Medical Devices & Imaging cluster by conducting primary and secondary research, tracking technology and innovation signals, evaluating companies and ecosystems, and developing high-quality client deliverables. The role requires the ability to understand both the technical and business dimensions of healthcare innovation and translate complex evidence into clear implications, growth opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
Core Areas of Focus
  
  

* Advanced diagnostics and point-of-care testing
* Medical imaging, including X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, CT, optical and hybrid imaging
* AI-enabled diagnostics, image analysis, clinical decision support and workflow automation
* Connected medical devices, remote patient monitoring, wearables and digital biomarkers
* Surgical robotics, image-guided interventions, navigation and visualization technologies
* Minimally invasive devices, endoscopy and interventional technologies
* Implantable, bioelectronic, neuromodulation and drug-delivery devices
* Personalized, home-based, virtual and decentralized care technologies
* Rehabilitation, assistive, ophthalmic, hearing and vision-care technologies
* Smart materials, sensors, microfluidics, electronics and manufacturing enablers for medical devices

**Responsibilities**
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Monitor and analyze emerging technologies, clinical innovations, product developments, regulatory milestones, patents, scientific publications, funding activity, partnerships, acquisitions, and commercialization signals across medical devices and imaging.
* Conduct structured secondary research using peer-reviewed literature, clinical-trial registries, patent databases, company disclosures, regulatory databases, government and health-agency publications, conference materials, and credible industry sources.
* Support primary research through interviews with clinicians, researchers, device manufacturers, technology developers, startups, investors, healthcare providers, and other subject matter experts.
* Assess technology readiness, clinical utility, unmet need, differentiation, adoption potential, regulatory considerations, reimbursement context, scalability, and commercial relevance.
* Develop technology landscapes, value-chain maps, ecosystem assessments, company profiles, innovation benchmarks, and opportunity-prioritization frameworks.
* Identify emerging signals and technology convergence across medical devices, imaging, AI, sensors, microelectronics, materials, advanced manufacturing, and digital health.
* Evaluate innovations across the care continuum, including pre-hospital, hospital, post-acute, remote, and home-based care settings.
* Analyze the implications of emerging technologies for R&D strategy, product portfolios, partnerships, market entry, care pathways, and future growth.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Specialist - Reliability Core
description:
**What’s The Role**
As Technical Specialist - Reliability Core, you will provide expert technical leadership in reliability engineering, maintenance strategy development, and asset performance improvement. You will lead complex Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) studies and reliability improvement initiatives across operating assets, turning equipment history, risk information, and operational insight into practical maintenance and improvement strategies.
  
  
This is a hands-on specialist role with a strong consulting and facilitation element. You will work with multidisciplinary asset teams, challenge technical assumptions constructively, assure the quality of reliability studies, and coach others in the effective application of reliability methods. You will also help teams make better use of analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities where these can deliver clear business value.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
Reliability Strategy & Asset Care
  
  
Reliability Engineering & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Apply reliability methods such as RCM, FMEA, RAM analysis, Weibull analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, and lifecycle cost analysis to support sound technical decisions.
* Identify recurring equipment failures, bad actors, and performance gaps, and lead structured reliability improvement activities to address them.
* Lead or support Root Cause Failure Analysis and Causal Learning investigations for significant or repeat equipment failures.
* Develop recommendations that are technically robust, proportionate to risk, and practical for asset teams to implement.
* Capture lessons learned and use them to improve reliability work processes, tools, and ways of working.

Reliability Statistical Analysis
  
  

* Apply advanced reliability statistical techniques to evaluate failure behaviour, predict equipment performance, and support maintenance strategy optimization.
* Perform Weibull Analysis, Crow-AMSAA Reliability Growth Modelling, and other probabilistic methods to assess failure patterns, reliability trends, and system improvement opportunities.
* Develop and utilize Monte Carlo Simulations to quantify uncertainty, assess risk scenarios, and support asset investment and lifecycle decisions.
* Conduct Remaining Useful Life (RUL) assessments and degradation modeling to support predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and intervention planning.
* Lead Asset Life Extension (ALE) studies by evaluating equipment condition, failure risk, operating context, and life-cycle economics to support safe and reliable operation beyond original design life.
* Translate statistical findings into actionable recommendations that improve asset availability, reliability performance, maintenance effectiveness, and business value.

Reliability analytics, digital and AI solutions
  
  

* Analyse equipment and maintenance data to identify failure trends, reliability risks, bad actors, and optimization opportunities.
* Develop or support reliability KPIs, dashboards, and analytical insights that enable timely and informed decision-making.
* Use reliability statistics and modelling to support maintenance, risk, and investment decisions.
* Identify practical opportunities for predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and AI-enabled reliability solutions.
* Collaborate with digital, analytics, and data science teams to translate reliability challenges into usable, value-focused solutions.
* Support adoption of digital reliability tools, intelligent agents, and data-driven workflows, with appropriate attention to data quality and user needs.

Technical leadership and assurance
  
  

* Provide expert review and technical assurance for complex reliability studies, maintenance strategies, and reliability improvement recommendations.
* Challenge assumptions, data quality, and proposed actions constructively to improve the quality of technical decisions.
* Provide guidance on the appropriate selection and application of reliability methods for different business problems.
* Act as a trusted subject matter expert for complex reliability and maintenance strategy challenges.
* Coach engineers and practitioners and contribute to the development of reliability capability across the organization.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Facilitate multidisciplinary workshops involving Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Inspection, and Technical Authorities.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship in reliability methodologies and best practices.
* Influence stakeholders and drive implementation of reliability recommendations.
* Interface with global asset teams, OEMs, vendors, and subject matter experts to deliver reliability improvements.

Business Impact
  
  
The role supports operating assets across Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, and Energy environments. Your work will contribute to safer and more reliable operations through improved asset availability, stronger maintenance effectiveness, reduced repeat failures, better risk management, and optimized lifecycle cost.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, Chemical, Manufacturing, or a related asset-intensive environment.

Core Reliability Competencies
  
  

* Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)
* Preventive Maintenance Optimization (PMO)
* Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA)
* Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Reliability, Availability & Maintainability (RAM)
* Mange Threat & Opportunity (MTO)
* Reliability Living Program

Reliability Statistical Analysis
  
  

* Weibull Analysis
* Reliability Growth Analysis
* Probability Distributions and Failure Modelling
* Reliability Forecasting
* Uncertainty and Sensitivity Analysis

Reliability Analytics & Digital Skills
  
  

* Reliability data analysis and performance trending.
* Development of reliability KPIs and dashboards.
* SAP PM/MM and enterprise asset management systems.
* Data-driven maintenance optimization methodologies.

AI & Emerging Digital Capabilities
  
  

* Understanding of AI and machine learning applications in asset reliability.
* Experience supporting predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, or AI-enabled reliability initiatives.
* Ability to work with digital, analytics, and data science teams to deliver business value.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology/Bio-Computing & AI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**

**Experience:**
PhD with 5–10 years post-PhD substantial hands-on experience in computational biology/bioinformatics, AI/ML, with demonstrated leadership of handling complex technical projects. Must have proficiency in Python/ relevant scientific computing & AI frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and associated data science libraries. Should be experienced with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, cloud-computing, GPU-based model training, or high-performance computing, DevOps & MLOps.

**Education: Ph.D**
. in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline with strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning models, & modern AI architectures.

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Research, Technology Product Development & AI Innovation

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly accomplished and visionary
**Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**
to lead the research, development, and deployment of innovative computational algorithms, large-scale machine learning models, and advanced artificial intelligence systems for multi-omics biological data.

The role will focus on building next-generation AI capabilities that integrate, analyze, and interpret complex, heterogeneous, and high-dimensional biological datasets, especially on
**multi-omics datasets and other molecular and clinical data modalities**
.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams in developing scalable AI/ML architectures, multimodal foundation models, predictive algorithms, and automated interpretation engines that transform complex biological data into clinically and scientifically meaningful insights. This position combines
**scientific innovation, AI/ML research leadership, computational platform development, and project/program management**
, requiring the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into robust, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI/ML Algorithm Development and Innovation**

* Lead the design and development of innovative computational algorithms and advanced machine learning models for biological data analysis, interpretation, and prediction.
* Develop novel approaches for extracting meaningful biological signals from complex, noisy, sparse, high-dimensional, and heterogeneous datasets.
* Drive research and implementation of deep learning, transformer-based architectures, graph neural networks, generative AI, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, and other advanced AI methodologies.
* Establish methodologies for model training, predictive modelling, model optimization, validation, benchmarking, explanability and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate promising research into scalable computational solutions.

**2. Multi-Omics Integration & Multimodal AI**

* Lead the development of algorithms and AI models capable of integrating and interpreting diverse biological data types.
* Design advanced computational frameworks for cross-modal data integration, representation learning, feature extraction, and biological knowledge discovery.
* Develop unified or interoperable AI models that learn from multiple data modalities and generate integrated biological and clinical interpretations.
* Address challenges associated with missing modalities, batch effects, technical variability, data sparsity, population heterogeneity, and differences across platforms and experimental technologies.
* Explore the development of multimodal biological foundation models capable of learning generalizable representations across datasets, diseases, populations, and use cases.

**3. Large-Scale Machine Learning and AI Model Development**

* Architect, develop, and manage large-scale AI/ML models trained on extensive and diverse biological, molecular, clinical, and biomedical datasets.
* Lead the development of domain-specific foundation models, including models for biological sequence understanding, molecular representation learning, disease signatures, & integrated multi-omics interpretation.
* Build scalable data-processing and model-training pipelines to support large datasets, distributed computing, GPU-based workloads, and high-throughput analytical workflows; and optimize computational efficiency, inference performance, reproducibility, scalability, and deployment readiness..
* Develop reusable model architectures, training frameworks, feature libraries, and computational components that can be applied across multiple scientific and clinical applications.
* Establish strategies for pretraining, fine-tuning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, & continual model improvement.

**4. Automated Biological and Clinical Data Interpretation**

* Lead development of automated interpretation engines that convert raw or processed biological data into structured, actionable, and scientifically grounded insights.
* Build AI-driven workflows that integrate data quality assessment, feature extraction, model inference, evidence aggregation, interpretation, & report generation.
* Develop computational approaches for identifying disease-associated molecular patterns, clinically relevant biomarkers, molecular subtypes, & potential mechanisms of disease to enable automated interpretation across multiple use case.
* Incorporate biological knowledge bases, pathway databases, literature-derived evidence, and other curated knowledge resources to improve interpretability & contextual relevance.

**5. Computational Biology Research and Scientific Leadership**

* Define the computational biology & AI research roadmap in alignment with organizational scientific, product, and business objectives; and translate emerging scientific discoveries & computational methodologies into practical AI capabilities.
* Identify high-impact novel research opportunities at the intersection of systems biology, multi-omics, machine learning, & precision medicine and lead development of novel methodologies, algorithms, prototypes, & proof-of-concept systems.
* Critically evaluate scientific literature, benchmark emerging methods, and establish best practices for computational research; incorporate methodological innovation, reproducible research, & publication-quality analytical standards.
* Collaborate with domain experts to ensure that developed models capture meaningful biological relationships rather than relying solely on statistical associations.

**6. Project and Program Management**

* Own end-to-end execution of complex AI and computational biology projects, from problem definition and feasibility assessment through research, development, validation, and deployment.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, budgets, and measurable success criteria, and manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize initiatives based on scientific value, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and business impact.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising computational biologists, bioinformaticians, laboratory scientists, clinicians, and product teams.
* Establish effective project governance, risk management, technical reviews, and performance reporting processes. Anticipate scientific, data, computational, regulatory, operational risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of robust, scalable, well-documented, and maintainable AI solutions.

**7. Data Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Development**

* Guide the design of scalable data architectures and computational pipelines for the ingestion, harmonization, transformation, and analysis of multi-omics & clinical datasets.
* Oversee the development of robust workflows for data preprocessing, quality control, normalization, feature engineering, and metadata management.
* Establish model development, deployment practices covering experiment tracking, version control, automated testing, model registries, monitoring, & reproducibility.
* Operationalize research models within production-grade computational platforms, APIs, analytical applications, and automated reporting systems, and promote cloud-native and distributed computing architectures where appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate data security, access controls, privacy protections, and governance throughout the data and model lifecycle.

**8. Model Validation, Explainability, and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous validation frameworks to assess model accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reproducibility, and clinical or scientific utility.
* Design appropriate benchmarking strategies, independent test sets, external validation studies, & prospective evaluation approaches where feasible, and evaluate model performance.
* Develop interpretable AI methods that help scientists & clinicians understand model predictions and their supporting evidence.
* Implement uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, bias assessment, & safeguards against unsupported interpretations.
* Work with clinical, quality, regulatory, and compliance teams to align development and validation practices with applicable requirements, particularly for intended clinical use.

**9. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across computational biology, AI/ML research, bioinformatics, and data science and establish a culture of innovation, scientific integrity, technical excellence, collaboration, & accountability.
* Communicate scientific findings, technical strategies, project status, and business implications to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Translate broad scientific and clinical requirements into clearly defined computational problems, development roadmaps, and measurable deliverables.
* Build cross-functional alignment among research, clinical, product, and commercial teams, and manage collaborations with all external stakeholders, where required.

title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
What you need to know about the role:
  
  
We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the analytical engine behind our payments economics. You'll own the data, reporting and dashboards that explain how our Total Processing Volume (TPV), revenue and transaction expenses (interchange, scheme fees and processing fees) turn into transaction margin. Most of our pricing is Interchange++ (IC+), so cost changes flow through to revenue.
  
  
Meet our team:
  
  
You'll join the Payments Finance team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager. The team owns revenue and transaction expense performance for the business. We work closely with Accounting on month-end close and reconciliation, with Corporate Finance on forecasting and planning, and with Product on pricing and margin initiatives. We're a small, hands-on team that values curiosity, ownership and clear answers to messy questions.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Facilitate collaborative engagement with business to cultivate strong partnership and unlock incremental value for the enterprise
* Ensure in-depth understanding of the business to proactively identify key business drivers
* Effectively communicate financial results & key drivers through concise & effective storytelling
* Streamline, improve, & automate designated workstreams and processes to drive efficiency
* Manage business case modeling, run deep dive analysis, and other ad-hoc financial analysis
* Monitor expense and headcount plan vs actual and provide analysis/recommendation for business partners and Finance team
* Work autonomously but in collaboration with teammates and business partners supporting a global business
* Guide the business through various finance-related tasks
* Own budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and reporting
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, and a broad group of business stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Your way to impact:**
Turn transaction-level data into clear insight on what is driving take rate, TE rate and margin: mix, card type, region, merchant segment, scheme fee changes and more.
  
  
Build the dashboards leadership uses to monitor payments performance, replacing manual spreadsheets with scalable, automated reporting.
  
  
Find margin opportunities, such as interchange optimization, scheme fee leakage, IC+ pass-through gaps and pricing outliers, and size them for Product and leadership.
  
  
Improve the accuracy of forecasts by giving Corporate Finance reliable volume and rate drivers.
  
  
Strengthen the link between operational data and the general ledger so our numbers tie out.
  
  
**In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:**

* Writing and maintaining SQL queries to pull and transform transaction, revenue and cost data.
* Building and maintaining dashboards in [Tableau / Looker / Power BI] tracking TPV, revenue, transaction expenses, take rate, TE rate and margin.
* Running monthly and quarterly variance analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. prior period) and explaining the drivers in plain language.
* Supporting month-end close by reconciling revenue and transaction expenses with Accounting.
* Monitoring scheme fee and interchange changes and quantifying their impact on cost and pass-through.
* Doing ad hoc deep dives for leadership and Product, for example merchant profitability or pricing scenarios.
* Documenting data definitions and metric logic so everyone uses one version of the truth.

**What do you need to bring:**

* 4+ years in FP&A, revenue analytics, business intelligence or a similar analytical role.
* Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions, CTEs, and working with large transaction-level datasets.
* Hands-on dashboarding experience in Tableau, Looker, Power BI or similar.
* Strong Excel/Sheets and financial modeling skills.
* A solid grasp of P&L concepts and variance analysis.
* The ability to explain complex numbers simply to non-finance partners.
* Payments experience is a strong plus: interchange, scheme fees, IC+ vs. blended pricing, acquiring and processing.
* Nice to have: Python, or data modeling experience; exposure to multi-currency or cross-border payments.
* undefined

PayPal

0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
