title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**
Let s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:
  
  
*shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io*

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**

– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.

Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.

GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

title: Senior Specialist - Market Risk
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Senior Specialist - Market Risk Operations will support the Gas & Power trading business by providing independent market risk measurement, exposure monitoring, P&L analysis, risk reporting, and control framework oversight. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex risk metrics into meaningful business insights for senior management.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Analyse and explain daily P&L movements and key portfolio risk drivers.
* Perform risk analysis using Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and other market risk methodologies.
* Monitor trading exposures and limits in accordance with the Trading Control Framework and Manual of Authorities (MOA).
* Provide insightful risk commentary on commodity trading portfolios, particularly Gas and Power.
* Conduct ad hoc data analysis and reporting using trading risk databases and reporting tools.
* Partner with traders, business stakeholders, and technology teams to investigate and resolve risk reporting and application issues.
* Develop and maintain reporting solutions, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Lead business improvement initiatives and risk-related projects with tight delivery timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, SOX controls, Shell Control Framework, and internal policies.

**What You Bring**

* Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of market risk concepts including VaR, stress testing, sensitivity analysis, basis risk, volume risk, and currency risk.
* Knowledge of commodity markets, preferably LNG, Natural Gas, and Power trading.
* Experience working with risk management platforms such as Endur and Nucleus.
* Strong technical and analytical skills with hands-on experience in:

+ SQL and Oracle
+ Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar data visualization tools

* Ability to analyse large datasets and communicate findings effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project leadership capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FRM or CFA certification.
* Experience supporting trading and risk management functions within commodity markets.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Pyspark Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**PySpark / Big Data Engineer**
to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Pipeline Design & Development**

* Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
* Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
* Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

**Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
* Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
* Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

**Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps**

* Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

**Governance, Security & Quality**

* Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

**Required Technical Qualifications & Skills**

* Core Technologies - Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x
* Database & Querying - Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions
* Data Lake & Lakehouse - Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC

* Cloud Platforms - AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)

* Distributed Computing Fundamentals: In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies).
* Production Experience: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale.
* Problem Solving: Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues.
* Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting.
* Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks platform (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow).
* Familiarity with Scala/Java in addition to Python.
* Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift).
* Relevant certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent)
* Educational Requirements
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation

Job Title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
  
  
GCL:D2
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn rigorous process design into enterprise outcomes that unlock time for discovery and better serve patients? As a Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation based in Chennai, you will report to the Process Optimisation Director and support the end-to-end management and evolution of our BPM platform. This permanent role blends deep analytical thinking with clear, impactful communication across a diverse global collaborator community.
  
  
You will help shape our strategy and standards, strengthen governance, and build a thriving BPM community of practice that delivers consistent, high-quality models ready for automation and insight. Your work will enable faster, smarter decision-making across the business by connecting process clarity to measurable efficiency and effectiveness. How will you translate complex operations into simple, reusable assets that scale across the enterprise?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* BPM Strategy and Framework: Co-develop the direction of our BPM approach; maintain methodologies, modeling standards, governance and guidelines so process assets are consistent, trusted and reusable.
* Platform Governance and Administration: Act as tool administrator; manage configurations, metadata and access; ensure data integrity; and communicate directly with software providers and internal technology teams to prioritize enhancements and resolve issues at pace.
* Process Modelling Excellence: Model and document end-to-end business processes using BPMN 2.0; guide strategic projects with high-quality process maps that drive efficiency, quality and compliance outcomes.
* Community Enablement and Training: Lead onboarding of new users to the BPM platform; deliver training and certification; run clinics and office hours to build capability and foster a collaborative, supportive community.
* Insight-Driven Optimisation: Analyse and redesign business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness; identify daily work optimisation opportunities using AI and link process insights to automation, mining and continuous improvement.
* Agile Delivery and Ways of Working: Operate within Agile methodology; manage backlogs and status analyses; work virtually across time zones with strong time management, balancing multiple initiatives without losing momentum.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Solid understanding of process modelling techniques, tools, frameworks and standards
* Strong experience in at least one BPM platform (e.g. BIC, Bizagi, Aris, Signavio etc.)
* Ability to model and document end to end business processes using BPMN 2.0
* Capable of acting as tool administrator and performing requirement gatherings and status analyses
* Ability to communicate/articulate requests directly to software providers, alongside other internal technological teams
* Analysing and designing business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness
* Ability to seek daily work activities optimisation with AI utilization
* Energetic and self-motivated
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple initiatives at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Proficiency in English
* Experience of working in Agile methodology

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience of various related BPM capabilities such Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience of working in Agile methodology
* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified
* Experience in change management projects and process optimization initiatives

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
****The Role****
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Applied AI team. This is a hands-on, generalist role working across Arcadia’s core ML and AI workstreams: utility data extraction, consumption forecasting, and agent-powered production workflows. You will work directly with senior data scientists and engineering to build, evaluate, and ship models that drive meaningful impact on central business operations.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to applied ML—from building classifiers and forecasting models to tuning prompts and supporting evaluation frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and extend production ML models for utility bill data extraction, including classifier and routing logic, LLM extraction prompts, and template confidence and accuracy analysis
* Build and iterate on forecasting models for operational use cases: predicting bill availability, estimating utility spend, and surfacing prioritization signals
* Contribute to audit and anomaly detection work—analyzing flagged bills, quantifying error rates, and helping tune tolerance thresholds
* Participate in offline experimentation and champion/challenger evaluations; document results clearly and compellingly to guide business decisions
* Work with data teams and subject matter experts to source, understand, and validate data; surface data quality issues proactively
* Write clean, well-documented Python code; contribute to shared notebooks and model development pipelines
* Collaborate with engineering to support model integration and monitoring; contribute to design docs and relevant code reviews

**What We're Not Looking For**
This is not a research role, a pure NLP or LLM engineering role, or a data analytics/BI role. Candidates whose experience is primarily in dashboarding, reporting, or model-free data work are not a fit. Candidates who have only worked in academic or research settings without production deployment experience should be screened carefully.
  
  
**What Will Help You Succeed**

* 1–3 years of experience building and evaluating ML models in a professional or research setting
* Solid foundation in statistics, supervised learning, classification, regression, and evaluation methodology (precision/recall, cross-validation, holdout testing)
* Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL
* Experience with time series data or forecasting is a plus
* Exposure to generative AI tools and LLM-based workflows
* Ability to work iteratively and independently—formulate assumptions, document them, and advance projects without constant direction
* Clear communicator: able to explain what a model does and what its results mean to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

title: AVP Barclaycard
description:

**Purpose of the role**

**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of stress testing methodologies and analysis of the results to identify potential vulnerabilities, assess capital adequacy, and inform risk mitigation strategies.

* Analysis of the bank's capital position and assessment of its ability to meet regulatory capital requirements, development of capital management strategies to optimise capital utilisation and evaluation of the impact of capital allocation decisions on the bank's risk profile and financial performance.

* Management of data, dataflows and data quality from contributors - input through to report submission.    .
* Management of BAU systems to enable a quick outcome and iterative generation of Capital or Funding plans and separately drive process reengineering initiatives.    .
* Ownership of the control's environment, standards, conformance, partnering with BIA to ensure the FTC meets its controls and governance objectives.   .

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engr III Spec-AI Science
description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled
**Engineer III, AI Science**
to design, build, and scale our next generation of AI systems. In this senior technical role, you will be a key driver in transitioning our machine learning capabilities from traditional predictive modeling to advanced Agentic and Prescriptive AI paradigms.
  
  
You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Agentic AI & LLM Development
* Design, build, and deploy multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
* Develop robust LLM-based applications capable of reasoning, tool-use, and executing complex, multi-step tasks for dynamic customer interactions and internal automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge), and prompt-engineering best practices to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant agent behavior in production.
* Predictive & Prescriptive Modeling
* Build state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence models, tree-based models) for forecasting customer behavior, churn, propensity, and lifetime value (CLTV).
* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.
* Production Engineering & MLOps
* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration
* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 5+ years of applied industry experience in machine learning, AI science, or data engineering (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* Technical Skills:Advanced proficiency in Python and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying LLMs and Agentic AI (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in Predictive and Prescriptive ML methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Engineering Best Practices: Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

title: Manager - Navigation & Control
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.

* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

  **externally funded and industry-sponsored research**
  .

  .

  **technology commercialisation / technology transfer / startup incubation**
  experience.
* Experience building
  **industry-funded laboratories or Centres of Excellence**
  .

The selected candidate will be expected to:

   **industry-sponsored and government-funded research programs**
   .

   **consultancy, technology development and industry projects**

title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It.
  
  
At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
  
  
When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
  
  
If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
  
  
engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities:**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**You bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
  
  
For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

**Job Description – AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**
**At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth**

**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move.**
**The Team**
The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi-cloud platforms, networks, and AI-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.
  
  
Our work is strategy-led and outcome-oriented, focused on helping executives make clear, data-driven decisions on topics such as:
  
  

* AI Infrastructure strategy
* AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
* Hybrid Cloud strategy
* Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
* Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
* Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
* Technology operating model and governance design
* AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies

Strategy professionals in this team act as trusted advisors to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, translating complex business problems into actionable technology choices. We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.
  
  
**Work You Will Do**
As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include supporting enterprise infrastructure and AI platform strategies (including hybrid and multi-cloud adoption roadmaps, investment prioritization, and value realization cases), advising clients on high-level AI-ready infrastructure architectures, designing target-state technology operating models, compute and token consumption strategies, including trade-offs between cost, performance, scalability and conducting strategic assessment and diagnostics across infrastructure, AI platforms and MLOps. This role provides exposure to complex, high-visibility transformation programs and enables you to build deep expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and enterprise infrastructure in a client-facing consulting environment.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* Ability to translate complex infrastructure and AI architecture concepts into clear business value narratives for executive and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong understanding of how infrastructure, cloud, data and AI investments drive growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, and operational resilience
* Ability to articulate emerging trends, best practices, and strategic implications of AI infrastructure and hybrid cloud adoption across industries
* Infrastructure, Cloud and AI domain knowledge:
* Foundational understanding of enterprise infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, and hybrid / multi-cloud architectures
* Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, inference) and concepts such as tokens, RAG, LLMs, Vector Databases etc.
* Understanding of cost drivers in AI and infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, token usage, cloud consumption models) and ability to support cost-benefit analysis and TCO evaluations
* Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, platforms, frameworks, ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NVIDIA AI platforms) and their infrastructure implications
* Understanding of key compliance, security, and regulatory standards relevant to Infrastructure and AI environments (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF)
* Architecture & Transformation Experience: Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience in either one or more of the following areas:
* AI or cloud infrastructure strategy, architecture, or large-scale transformation initiatives
* Design or assessment of AI/ML platforms, MLOps workflows, or AI-ready infrastructure environments
* Infrastructure modernization, cost optimization, or operating model transformation programs
* AI Economics and optimization
* Exposure to integrating compute, networking, and storage capabilities to support scalable AI or cloud workloads, with an emphasis on architectural decision-making rather than hands-on operations
* Experience supporting ecosystem-driven solutions and working with technology partners to shape solution options and recommendations
* Ability to support benchmarking, performance assessments, and business case development to inform infrastructure and AI investment decisions
* Experience defining target operating models (TOMs), roadmaps, governance frameworks, and process designs
* Exposure to security, governance, and compliance considerations across infrastructure and AI stacks
* Interest in contributing to internal knowledge development, POVs, or client thought leadership as part of broader practice growth
* Exposure to working with non-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders

**Core Consulting Skills**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization

* MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, etc.

* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends related to Big Data, continuously evaluating new tools and frameworks for potential integration.

**Education\***

* Graduation / Post Graduation

+ B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/ MCA

* Certifications If Any:

+ Not Mandatory

**Experience Range\***

* 15+ Years

**Foundational Skills\***
