title: Master Data Quality Manager
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation.The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained.

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data quality monitoring**

* Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data.
* Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards.
* Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions.
* Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records.
* Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes.
* Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

**2. Data Cleansing and Remediation**

* Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets.
* Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies.
* Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information.
* Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner.

**3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding**

* Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data.
* Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment.
* Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data.
* Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements.
* Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions.
* Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information.

**4. Data governance and standardization**

* Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data.
* Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained.
* Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality.
* Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures.
* Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation.

**5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support**

* Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information.
* Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions.
* Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues.
* Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices.

**6. Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress.
* Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action.
* Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes.
* Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
* Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment.
* Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented.
* Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically.
* Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products.
* Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms.
* Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting.
* Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes.
* Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

**Requirements**

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

**Technical Requirements**

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience With**

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

**Must-Have Capabilities**

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A general infrastructure delivery or ticket-queue role measured primarily by throughput, or a position intended to backfill on-call coverage. Operational experience informs the work; capacity and demand planning remain the primary focus.
* Ownership of approved forecasts, spend approval, procurement or investment recommendations and decisions, architecture, team backlog priorities, or the FinOps program. You develop analytical inputs and options in partnership with the accountable owners.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior specialist FinOps experience or certification, and experience supporting cloud cost optimization or commitment analysis. These are preferred, not required.

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Senior

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join a high-performing SAP Analytics and Data team to help organizations unlock business value through data-driven insights. As an SAP BDC Consultant, you will work on designing, developing, and implementing enterprise data and analytics solutions using SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and related technologies. You will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, innovative, and high-quality data solutions that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, and SAP BW/4HANA data models.
* Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Build and optimize data pipelines, transformations, and integration processes.
* Develop analytical models, reports, and dashboards using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Integrate SAP and non-SAP data sources to support enterprise analytics requirements.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.
* Support data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with business users, architects, and project teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize data models and reporting solutions.
* Prepare technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, and SAP Business Data Cloud concepts.
* Experience in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing principles.
* Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting and planning capabilities.
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA data structures and analytical content.
* Experience with SQL, SAP HANA modelling, and data integration techniques.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.
* Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail and quality.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* SAP certifications in Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAC, or related SAP technologies.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, or other SAP functional domains.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
**Agentic AI flow testing**
and
**RAG pipeline validation**
to
**AI safety, test automation**
, and
**performance & reliability engineering**
.
  
  
You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
**safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready**
at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Agentic AI Testing
  
  

* Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing
  
  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.

Test Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.

**AI Safety & Security Testing**

* Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:

+ Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.

Performance & Reliability Testing
  
  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery & Client Program Lead**

**Full Time | Chennai |**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape & help establish standards.

This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.

You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.

This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client-facing, with solid team-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* Own the end-to-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi, Qlik Replicate, AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data warehousing, modelling, and reporting.
* Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and governance frameworks - and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.
* Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices.
* Lead technical implementation and stay hands-on where it matters - reviewing designs, unblocking the team, and building critical components.
* Own solution design decisions and their trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and business audiences.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.
* Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (scrum-master responsibilities).
* Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
* Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.
* Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.
* Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.
* Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.
* Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical audiences.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 3+ years in a data architecture capacity.
* Strong Snowflake experience - able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.
* Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices (RBAC, data security).
* Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and governance framework.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling - one or more of Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi - and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.
* Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.
* Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team-management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.
* Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business stakeholders.
* Experience running agile delivery - sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.
* Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.
* Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS + Talend + Boomi).
* Data governance, security, and role-based access / access-model design.
* Experience delivering into a large, standards-driven enterprise - ideally in manufacturing or a comparable industrial / operational domain.
* Migration, go-live, or platform-modernization experience.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change-management processes.
* Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.

* Informatica Cloud (IICS) certification

* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops

* Decision-making under ambiguity

Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist who can set the technical direction for a workstream, make architecture and modeling decisions, and lead a small team of Data Scientists/Engineers.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience across the complete ML lifecycle and be capable of acting as the senior technical authority for client-facing discussions.

* Own the complete model lifecycle from problem framing and feature engineering through training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.

* Design and execute rigorous experiments including A/B testing, causal inference and uplift modeling.
* Build production-grade feature pipelines and training infrastructure.
* Work with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark, Ray or equivalent.
* Monitor production models for drift and degradation and determine retraining, redesign or rollback strategies.
* Establish technical standards for modeling, code reviews, experiment tracking and model validation.
* Mentor and technically guide 2–4 Data Scientists/Engineers.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients.
* Explain model trade-offs, limitations, assumptions and failure modes to non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive GenAI/LLM solutions including retrieval design, evaluation frameworks and production reliability.
* Implement MLOps practices including model registries, automated retraining and ML CI/CD.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

October 16, 2026 - October 29, 2026

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Business Data Insights Senior Specialist
description:

The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role: Data & AI Engineer**
**Work Experience**
5+ years of combined experience in data engineering and AI/ML engineering, including building scalable data pipelines and cloud data platforms as well as developing and deploying machine learning or generative AI solutions, in an Agile or DevOps environment.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a skilled and versatile Data & AI Engineer who can own the full data-to-AI lifecycle — designing and building robust data pipelines using Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, and then using that data to build, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and generative AI solutions with Azure Machine Learning and Azure OpenAI.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience across both disciplines: developing ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming structured and semi-structured data, and ensuring reliable data availability, as well as building RAG pipelines, integrating LLM-based solutions, and operationalizing models with MLOps best practices.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* 4+ years of experience spanning data engineering and AI/ML engineering, with strong exposure to data integration, ETL/ELT development, and cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for building, scheduling, monitoring, and managing data pipelines.

* Experience with Azure Databricks, including notebooks, Spark SQL, PySpark, data transformation, and performance optimization.

* Experience with data modelling, data quality checks, data profiling, reconciliation, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* Exposure to DevOps practices such as Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), version control, and deployment processes.
* Working knowledge of Power BI or similar reporting tools, and knowledge of legacy ETL tools (Informatica, SSIS, Teradata, Oracle) will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, SQL, and related technologies.

* Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets, preparing them for both analytics and model training/evaluation.
* Develop data and model transformation logic using SQL, PySpark, Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, and Python ML frameworks.
* Create and maintain reliable data flows and AI services across raw, curated, and consumption-ready layers, including production model inference.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI developers, product owners, and architects to convert requirements into technical data and AI solutions.
* Support data migration, system integration, and AI feature rollout, from legacy platforms to cloud-based data and AI platforms.

* Implement data quality rules, responsible AI practices, exception handling, logging, audit checks, and operational controls.
* Contribute to documentation of data flows, model architecture, source-to-target mappings, technical designs, and operational support procedures.
* Participate in E2E product lifecycle activities including design, development, testing, deployment, run support, retraining, refactoring, and decommissioning of outdated solutions.
* Continuously improve existing data and AI engineering processes through automation, standardization, and reusable components.

**Business And Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of both data engineering and AI/ML concepts — data pipelines, data integration, data modelling, model lifecycle, and cloud-based platforms.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs spanning data and AI.
* Experience in working with data structures, storage systems, model architectures, data quality frameworks, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows, upstream and downstream dependencies, and AI/reporting consumption patterns.
* Ability to quickly analyze existing data and AI solutions and recommend improvements, automation opportunities, or alternative approaches.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across pipelines, databases, models, and application layers.
* Experience working in Agile teams with E2E ownership of deliverables, from data ingestion through to deployed AI features.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation skills, including technical design documents, model cards, process flows, data mapping, and support guides.

**General Skills**

* Strong team player with the ability to work independently when required.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable and scalable data and AI solutions.
* Open to learning new technologies and applying them to improve existing processes.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand end-to-end business processes and data/AI dependencies.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical data and AI concepts in a simple and clear manner.
* Proactive approach toward automation, optimization, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Azure Data Engineering, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, or generative AI technologies will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Technology Stack**
**Cloud & Data Platform:**
Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks
  
  
**Cloud & AI Platform:**
Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Studio, Azure OpenAI Service
  
  
**Programming & Querying:**
SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks:**
PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel
  
  
**Data & AI Engineering:**
ETL, ELT, data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, MLOps
  
  
**Vector Search & Data:**
Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone, vector databases
  
  
**BI & Reporting:**
Power BI, SSRS or equivalent visualization tools
  
  
**DevOps & Delivery:**
Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Agile delivery practices

Informatica, SSIS, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server

title: Senior Data Governance Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Data Governance Engineer**

  
  

**Location:**
Chennai, India

  
  

**Job Type:**
Full-time

  
  

**Function:**
Technology / Data

  
  

**Reports to:**
Raja Krishnamoorthi

  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We are building the world’s leading learning company by providing digital content, assessments, and services that support learners at every stage.

  
  

As part of Pearson’s Chief Technology Office (OCTO), the Keystone Data Governance team is responsible for enabling trusted, high-quality, and compliant data across the enterprise. We are transforming how data is governed by embedding automation, scalability, and modern data engineering practices into our governance model.

  
  

**The Role**

  
  

We are seeking highly motivated
**Data Governance Engineers**
to join our Chennai-based team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building and scaling automated Data Governance capabilities across Pearson’s data ecosystem.

  
  

This role is primarily an
**engineering-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands-on engineering, 20–30% governance-related work)**
. The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.

  
  

You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Governance Engineering & Automation**

  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.
  
  
* Translate governance policies into scalable, technical implementations embedded within data platforms (with guidance from senior team members as needed).
  
  
* Together with US-based Data Governance team, develop reusable frameworks and patterns that enable consistent governance adoption across business units.
  

  

**Collibra Platform & Integration**

  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API-based integrations.
  
  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  
  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  

  

**Metadata & Data Catalog Management**

  

  
* Support the build-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  
  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  
  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  

  

**Data Quality Engineering**

  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  
  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  
  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  

  

**Data Compliance, Security & Privacy**

  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  
  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  
  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  

  

**Data Engineering & Integration**

  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  
  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  
  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  

  

**Collaboration & Delivery**

  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand-up meetings with US-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  
  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  
  

**Required (Core Engineering Skills)**

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.

* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.

title: Quality Specialist - Tamil, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Tamil language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing.)
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
* Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline).
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops.
* Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams.

description:

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Caterpillar’s Autonomy and Automation Group is building the autonomous planning platform that moves machines and manipulates terrain across construction sites.
  
  
As a Path Planning Engineer, you will design the navigation and terrain planning that lets autonomous machines drive, dig, and dump safely and efficiently — from stationary digging to high-speed machine navigation. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in developing path planning algorithms, perception techniques and implementing production quality software in C++.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop navigation planning — route generation, path planning over drivable terrain, and obstacle avoidance
* Build motion planning that issues control commands to accurately track planned paths
* Design terrain planning that decides where machines engage terrain — dig, dump, and push
* Deliver long-horizon planning for both onboard and offboard execution
* Create reusable planning libraries and common data objects such as path geometry and zones
* Develop search and optimization algorithms and motion & terrain interaction prediction models
* Develop production quality code and own your algorithms from design to production
* Run simulation for path planning algorithm development and test various scenarios
* Test code on construction equipment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related engineering field
* Strong foundation in motion and path planning, including search and sampling-based methods such as A\*, RRT, and graph search
* Proficiency in C++ and/or Python for real-time robotics software
* Experience with autonomous ground vehicles, mobile robots, or off-road navigation
* Working knowledge of kinematics, dynamics, and control for path tracking
* Track record building modular, reusable software libraries with clean interfaces

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with off-highway or heavy equipment such as excavators, loaders, and trucks
* Familiarity with terrain modeling and machine-terrain interaction prediction
* Knowledge of perception, localization, and mapping (SLAM)
* Exposure to ROS, simulation, and field testing of autonomy

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
  
  
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
  
  
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
  
  
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
  
  
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

title: Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Investigations
description:
**Job Summary**
Client & Third Party Security (CTPS) is a specialist team within the Bank’s Group Threat Management (GTM) function, forming part of Information & Cyber Security (ICS) function. The team plays a critical role in delivering the Group’s ICS Strategy by helping build a comprehensive, threat-focused understanding of its external ecosystem, including third party vendors, key partners, and clients. CTPS helps protect the Bank by managing third-party cyber risk end-to-end through delivery of Third Party Security Assessments, contractual control oversight, third party continuous monitoring, detection, analysis and investigation of third party incidents, and targeted remediation of third party security observations. As the threat landscape continues to evolve, CTPS is going through an exciting transformation to become more threat-led, risk-focused and efficient — strengthening supply chain security capabilities and improving detection and remediation of interconnected third-party risks.
  
  
The Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Incident Investigations will be part of a specialist team responsible for the proactive detection, analysis and investigation of cyber security incidents impacting the Bank’s third party ecosystem. Sitting within CTPS, this role will play a critical part in strengthening the Bank’s ability to identify emerging third party threats, assess potential exposure, coordinate response activity and clearly articulate risk to senior stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep expertise across a broad range of cyber security domains including cyber threat intelligence, forensic investigations, incident response and third party security risk management. They will be responsible for supporting investigations into third party incidents and ensuring findings are translated into clear business, operational, client and regulatory risk insights. The role will require strong judgement in high-pressure situations, including determining the potential impact of incidents on Bank data, services, systems, clients and critical third party dependencies.
  
  
This role will also be responsible for engaging directly with senior internal and external stakeholders, including CISOs, CIOs and senior representatives of breached or impacted third parties. The role holder must be able to communicate clearly, challenge effectively, obtain meaningful assurance from third parties and brief complex technical and investigative findings in a clear, concise and business-relevant manner.
  
  
As CTPS continues to strengthen its threat-led and intelligence-enabled approach to third party security risk management, this role will be central to ensuring the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving external threat landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Support the ongoing maturity of CTPS’ third party incident investigations and intelligence programme, ensuring alignment with the wider ICS strategy and the Bank’s approach to managing third party cyber security risk.
* Support the evolution of third party incident detection and investigation capabilities to ensure the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving, increasingly complex and supply-chain-focused external threat landscape.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance the Bank’s overall security posture through new detection capabilities, improved intelligence workflows, enhanced investigation standards and broader programme improvements.

**Business**

* Maintain awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy, operating model and third party ecosystem.
* Facilitate business continuity by proactively identifying, assessing and helping mitigate cyber threats targeting the Bank’s clients, third party suppliers and wider supply chain.
* Lead engagements with Contract Managers when investigating third party compromises, ensuring business stakeholders understand potential impact, required actions and escalation pathways.
* Translate complex cyber threat intelligence and investigation findings into clear business, operational and regulatory impact assessments.

**Processes**

* Responsible for operating third party incident detection, triage, investigation, impact assessment and intelligence reporting processes.
* Ensure suspected third party incidents are recorded, validated, investigated, classified and escalated in line with CTPS operating procedures and relevant incident management requirements.
* Maintain rules, alerts and workflows to enhance discovery of relevant intelligence across threat intelligence platforms, monitoring tools, dark web sources, ransomware leak sites and other relevant intelligence sources.
* Pivot on relevant Indicators of Compromise, including domains, IP addresses, infrastructure, threat actor identifiers and other artefacts, to investigate associated threats, actors, infrastructure and potential Bank exposure.
* Adopt consistent investigation standards, evidence requirements, quality assurance expectations and documentation practices.
* Ensure lessons learned from investigations are fed back into relevant control domains, including threat detection, continuous monitoring, third party reassessments, control uplift and executive reporting.

**Risk Management**

* Identify, assess, monitor and support mitigation of cyber risks arising from incidents impacting the Bank’s third party suppliers, clients and broader third party ecosystem.
* Ensure timely escalation of material third party incidents, suspected compromises, control weaknesses and emerging threat trends through appropriate CTPS, ICS and Group risk channels.
* Provide risk-based recommendations to support containment, assurance requests, remediation actions, reassessment triggers, continuous monitoring prioritisation and potential disconnection decisioning.
* Support responsibilities under the Group’s Risk Management Framework by ensuring third party incident risks are identified, assessed, documented, escalated and monitored in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Provide effective challenge where third party responses, assurance evidence, remediation plans or business risk decisions do not sufficiently address the underlying cyber risk exposure.

**Governance**

* Ensure the effectiveness of third party incident detection, investigation, reporting and response arrangements, and suggest improvements where required.
* Ensure that outputs from third party incident investigations are aligned to CTPS governance requirements, ICS risk appetite, incident management expectations and relevant regulatory considerations.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Head, Client & Third-Party Security
* Director, Third Party Intelligence & Investigations
* Global Head, Group Threat Management
* Cyber Intelligence Centre
* Threat Assessment & Countermeasures
* Market, Business and Function CISOs
* Technology & Operations Third Party Risk Management Utility team
* Supply Chain Management
* Group Threat Management 1st Line Risk & Control team
* Operational, Technology & Cyber Risk team

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the CTPS team

**Skills And Experience**

As a Data Engineer on the Global Parts Pricing Data Engineering team, you will design and build scalable data platforms, pipelines, and cloud solutions that power pricing decisions across a global business. You will solve complex data challenges, transform diverse data sources into trusted and actionable insights, and deliver solutions that drive significant business outcomes. Working alongside data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders, you will develop high-performance data products, automate critical processes, and help shape the future of data and AI-driven pricing determination.

* Data Modeling & Integration: Knowledge of data modeling, transformation, and integration techniques; ability to consolidate diverse data sources into well-governed, consumable data products.
* Data Observability & Quality: Experience implementing data quality frameworks, monitoring, testing, and automated validation to ensure reliable and trusted data assets.
* Collaboration & Business Impact: Ability to partner with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver data solutions that support pricing decisions, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled outcomes.

* Experience with AI assisted software development (ex. Github Copilot, Cursor, Codex, etc)
